proof: Each selected edge is strict two-bin majorization. Disjoint bins make all occupancy and profile deltas independent; disjoint calls make simultaneous family replacement independent. Their sum preserves rank mass and lowers every p-power moment for0<p<1. All baseline source constraints and a fresh full literal audit remain mandatory.
